A warm path opens beneath your companions' feet. They lift their faces and step out of the fear together.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Up to three visible willing creatures within 4 squares, including yourself.
Type
Magic / Recovery / Movement

Each target reduces temporary Frightened by 1 and may move up to 2 squares without provoking to a free supported square.
